title: Calendar Invite Malware
scenario: A calendar invite contains an attachment titled 'agenda' from an unknown organizer.

answers.A: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.B: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.C: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Calendar Invite Malware: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Unexpected invite attachments should not be opened.
